title: Find the LinkedIn Profiles of Fortune 500 CEOs With LinkFinder AI
coverSub: From names and companies to the right LinkedIn profile URLs
cover: In this video we are going to see how to find the LinkedIn profiles of Fortune 500 CEOs using LinkFinder AI.
payoff: Here is what you end up with. 8 CEOs and their companies went in, and every one came back with the right LinkedIn profile. Now let's see how.
outro: That's the whole flow: names and companies in, LinkedIn profiles out. Click the first link in the description to create your free account and run your own list. Next, watch how to find the work email behind each of these profiles.
outroHeadline: Match your own list to LinkedIn
outroSub: Free account, credits included. First link in the description.

mocks._source: Real results of find_linkedin_url_from_name (LinkFinder AI API), 12 Nov 2026

click.text: I just need one lookup for now

steps.narration: Keep Name plus company. It costs one credit per person.
Fill in the full name. We type Mary Barra.
Fill in the company: General Motors. The company is what tells two people with the same name apart.
A few seconds later you have Mary Barra's LinkedIn profile, linkedin dot com slash in slash mary barra.
Now a whole list. Click Upload CSV, bulk.
Click Select File and pick your CSV, with a name column and a company column. Ours has 8 Fortune 500 CEOs.
LinkFinder AI maps the name and company columns and shows the rows before anything runs.
The profiles come in row by row: Jamie Dimon, Andy Jassy, Sundar Pichai. Note Jensen Huang's real slug, jen hsun huang: guessing it would have failed.
8 people in, 8 LinkedIn profiles out, every one marked Found.
Click Export to download the list as a CSV. Next step: find the work email behind each profile.
